_comments.purpose: Extensions fetched from upstream repos at install time into extensions/<name>/ of the pi agent dir. Installed by scripts/lib/upstream-extensions.sh.
_comments.pinning: Unlike external-skills.json (which tracks the default branch), every entry is pinned to a full commit SHA in 'ref', so an install is reproducible and upstream changes cannot alter what runs inside pi.
_comments.license: The subagent example is MIT licensed (earendil-works/pi).
_comments.files: Only the listed files are copied. The upstream sample agents/ and prompts/ are not installed: this repo ships its own worker and scout agents and prompt templates.
_comments.version_mismatch: Extensions use pi's internal APIs. If the installed pi version no longer matches, bump 'ref' to a commit matching that version and re-run install with -f.
_comments.failure: Missing git or jq, a network failure, or a missing listed file warns and skips that entry; the rest of the install continues.
